purpose.zh: 在分腿坐姿下练双腿屈伸控制
purpose.en: Train bending and straightening your legs in a straddle.

text.zh: 双脚离地，膝盖向两侧打开收腿再伸直
text.en: Keep your feet off the floor, fold your knees open to the sides, then straighten

text.zh: 双手在骨盆前方撑地，胸口朝前
text.en: Place your palms in front of your pelvis and keep your chest facing forward.

text.zh: 不后仰，动作慢而有控制
text.en: Do not lean back; move slowly with control.

cautions.zh: 髋部或腰部疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your hips or lower back hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
